Deputy Secretary-General of ASEAN for Community and Corporate Affairs, H.E. Nararya S. Soeprapto, delivered opening remarks at the 2026 Model ASEAN–ROK Summit, held today at the ASEAN Secretariat/Headquarters. Organised by the Chung Mong-Koo (CMK) School of ASEAN Studies as part of its 2026 ASEAN Day project, the Model ASEAN-ROK Summit aims to deepen students’ understanding of ASEAN–Republic of Korea relations and regional cooperation. In his remarks, DSG Nararya emphasised that the collaboration demonstrates the strength of ASEAN–ROK cooperation and reflects a shared commitment to providing platforms for young people to learn, lead, and contribute meaningfully to regional community-building.

Deputy Secretary-General of ASEAN for Community and Corporate Affairs, H.E. Nararya S. Soeprapto, today received a courtesy call from H.E. Carsten Schmitz-Hoffmann, Director General of Latin America, Europe, North Africa / Near and Middle East, Asia Department of GIZ, at the ASEAN Headquarters/ASEAN Secretariat. The Meeting exchanged views on ongoing development cooperation between GIZ and ASEAN and explored potential areas for further collaboration and synergies within the ASEAN framework. DSG Nararya expressed his appreciation to GIZ for its invaluable support to ASEAN’s community-building efforts and looked forward to further collaboration in advancing the ASEAN Community Vision 2045.

#WATCH | Delhi: Congress MP Kumari Selja says, "We have just come to the Election Commission. We wanted to submit a memorandum regarding the massive irregularities taking place in Uttarakhand under the guise of 'SIR', where the names of so many eligible voters are being struck off the electoral rolls. People are arbitrarily declared absent from their place of residence, and young individuals are falsely marked as deceased... Notices are ostensibly issued but never actually reach the recipients, and no action is being taken against those responsible for these malpractices. The way this government is functioning is appalling. What is truly disheartening is that the EC is failing to assert its authority and stand above the government's flawed policies... This government has no faith in the Constitution or constitutional institutions..." He adds, "...Here, we stand, being told not to cross the barricades, even though we are known to everyone here. We managed to get past the barricades, yet the massive lock on the gate remained unopened; it is deeply disheartening to be forced into such a situation. We are compelled to sit and raise slogans in front of such a prestigious institution. Then, one of their officers came out; they were speaking to us through the bars. Is this how things are handled? This upholds neither the dignity of the EC nor that of democracy... we insisted and urged them. Eventually, they agreed to let us come inside, a group of seven people. What threat did the EC perceive from 7-8 people?... why is the EC so terrified today?... We are merely representatives; answers must be given to the people. The Modi government must answer for keeping the EC confined like a bird in a cage..." Video ANI (@ANI) #WATCH | Delhi: Congress MP Kumari Selja and other party leaders reach outside the office of the Election Commission of India to submit a memorandum regarding SIR in Uttarakhand. #WATCH | Delhi: On the Delhi Master Plan 2047, Union Minister Manohar Lal Khattar says, "There is a proposal to develop '24-hour city' zones, where operations continue around the clock. Provisions are being made to ensure 24-hour transportation services, particularly metro connectivity, for these locations. Similarly, plans have been formulated for low-density areas; these include provisions for internal roads with an 18-meter width and master trunk roads with a 45-meter Right of Way (ROW). To manage congestion effectively, the layout requires leaving open space along the plots on both sides of the 15-to-18-meter internal roads. Regarding the plots carved out in these zones, owners will be granted TDR (Transferable Development Rights) and FAR (Floor Area Ratio) based on a standard 2.5-acre benchmark; this ensures that even if a plot is smaller than 2.5 acres, the owner receives the full FAR entitlement associated with a 2.5-acre plot. Consequently, farmhouses cannot be constructed in these low-density development zones on plots smaller than 2.5 acres...." Video

With its strikes on Moscow, Ukraine is taking disruption to a new level. The success of a long-range strike is not measured by impact alone. Even an intercepted attack closes airspace, disrupts flights and logistics, and erodes the sense of security. Russia cannot protect everything. It has more targets than air defences. Hitting the target magnifies the effect, but disruption begins before destruction. Yes, Russia will continue firing ballistic missiles at Ukrainian cities. But Putin’s problem is that Ukrainian suffering will no longer compensate Russians for disruption at home. As that disruption spreads, Russians will increasingly blame Putin and his corrupt regime for breaking the central bargain underpinning his rule since 2022: war was supposed to be something Ukrainians suffer, not them. The choice is Putin’s: wind down the war to preserve control, or tighten control at home to keep the war going. I would love to be wrong, but everything we know about him suggests he will choose the latter.

I congratulated the Ambassador of France to Ukraine @FranceenUkraine, Brice Roquefeuil, on the start of his work in Kyiv. We discussed strengthening the resilience of Ukraine’s energy system, supporting critical infrastructure, and accelerating the implementation of joint projects. In particular, we discussed expanding grant support for additional projects in the regions. We are grateful to France for its contributions through the URTF and the Ukraine Energy Support Fund, which have enabled the procurement of transformers and strengthened the physical protection of energy facilities. A separate area of cooperation is nuclear energy: modernisation of Ukrainian NPPs, diversification of nuclear fuel supply routes, development of uranium resources, digitalisation of equipment monitoring, and strengthening nuclear safety. We are preparing for the Conference in Paris. We count on France’s active role in mobilising international support for the restoration of the New Safe Confinement at the Chornobyl NPP, as well as its active participation in coordinating the Energy Ramstein and preparing for the next meeting. The mission was the result of years of planning with federal, state, local, tribal, and international partners. যুক্তরাষ্ট্রের মোট সরকারি ঋণ প্রথমবারের মতো ৪০ ট্রিলিয়ন (৪০ লাখ কোটি) ডলার ছাড়িয়েছে। সামাজিক নিরাপত্তা কর্মসূচি ও সুদ পরিশোধ করতে গিয়ে ব্যয় যেভাবে হু হু করে বাড়ছে, সে তুলনায় করছাড়ের কারণে রাজস্ব আদায় অনেক কম হচ্ছে। ফলে এক বড় ধরনের আর্থিক সংকটের আশঙ্কা করা হচ্ছে। যুক্তরাষ্ট্রের অর্থ মন্ত্রণালয়ের সর্বশেষ দৈনিক নগদ অর্থ ও ঋণস্থিতি বিবরণী অনুযায়ী, গত মঙ্গলবার সরকারি ঋণের পরিমাণ বেড়ে দাঁড়িয়েছে ৪০ দশমিক শূন্য ৪৭ ট্রিলিয়ন (৪০ লাখ ৪ হাজার ৭০০ কোটি) ডলার। এর মধ্যে জনগণের কাছে থাকা ট্রেজারি সিকিউরিটিজের পরিমাণ ৩২ দশমিক ২৬৬ ট্রিলিয়ন ডলার ও সরকারের বিভিন্ন সংস্থার ঋণ ৭ দশমিক ৭৮২ ট্রিলিয়ন ডলার। মাত্র এক দশকের কম সময়ে যুক্তরাষ্ট্রের সরকারি ঋণ দ্বিগুণের বেশি বেড়েছে। ২০১৭ সালের জানুয়ারিতে ডোনাল্ড ট্রাম্প প্রথমবার প্রেসিডেন্টের দায়িত্ব নেওয়ার সময় দেশটির সরকারি ঋণ ছিল ১৯ দশমিক ৯৫ ট্রিলিয়ন ডলার। সরকারি ঋণ বৃদ্ধির প্রায় এক-তৃতীয়াংশই ঘটেছে ট্রাম্প ও সাবেক প্রেসিডেন্ট জো বাইডেনের আমলে কোভিড-১৯ মহামারির ধাক্কা সামলাতে সরকারের নেওয়া জরুরি ঋণ কর্মসূচির কারণে। বাকি দুই-তৃতীয়াংশ ঋণের জন্য দায়ী এ দুই প্রেসিডেন্টের নেওয়া আর্থিক নীতি এবং দীর্ঘদিনের কর ও ব্যয়ের মধ্যকার কাঠামোগত ভারসাম্যহীনতা। #USDebt #USeconomy #GlobalEconomy #somoytv

Dr. Ashok K. Lahiri, Vice Chairperson, NITI Aayog, addressed the ICRA Leadership Summit on “Reframing Perspectives on Corporate India and Infrastructure amid Evolving Headwinds” in New Delhi. In his address, Dr. Lahiri highlighted India’s strong economic fundamentals and emphasised the need for continued momentum to achieve the vision of Viksit Bharat@2047. He underscored the importance of rapid industrialisation, greater corporate investment, technology adoption, and stronger manufacturing and export capabilities to drive productivity, employment, and growth. He also highlighted the critical role of resilient infrastructure and integrated planning through initiatives such as PM GatiShakti, while stressing the need for greater private sector participation and addressing domestic bottlenecks in project execution. Dr. Lahiri called for Indian corporates to leverage the opportunities emerging from global shifts, scale up investment, strengthen competitiveness, and contribute to India’s journey towards becoming a developed economy by 2047. #ICRA #CorporateIndia @PMOIndia @narendramodi @Rao_InderjitS @MIB_India @PIB_India @DDNewslive @ashoklahiribjp

The Democratic Republic of the Congo (#DRC) will receive Ervebo vaccines from the global Ebola virus disease vaccine stockpile for use in the current Bundibugyo virus disease outbreak. The Ervebo vaccine is licensed and recommended for use in outbreaks of Ebola virus (previously known as Zaire ebolavirus) disease. The current allocation includes 20 000 doses for a Phase 3 clinical trial to understand the impact of the vaccine on the Bundibugyo virus, and 50 000 doses for frontline and health workers in line with the current Strategic Advisory Group of Experts on Immunization (SAGE) recommendations. Deputy Prime Minister/Foreign Minister Senator Mohammad Ishaq Dar @MIshaqDar50 held wide-ranging delegation-level talks with Syrian Foreign Minister H.E. Mr. Asaad Hassan al-Shaibani, welcoming his visit to Pakistan. The two sides reaffirmed the longstanding brotherly ties between Pakistan and Syria and agreed to further strengthen bilateral cooperation across areas of mutual interest. The Ministers also exchanged views on regional and international developments, including Palestine, the Golan Heights, Afghanistan, the situation in South Asia, and developments in the Middle East. DPM/FM reaffirmed Pakistan’s support for Syria’s sovereignty, unity, and territorial integrity. The Syrian Foreign Minister welcomed the signing of the Makkah Joint Defence Agreement and commended Pakistan’s constructive role in promoting regional peace and stability, including its efforts towards de-escalation in the US-Iran context. Both sides reaffirmed their commitment to continued engagement and cooperation for peace, stability, and prosperity in the region and beyond.

দক্ষিণ কোরিয়ার আনসান জামে মসজিদে বাংলাদেশি আলেম ও ইমাম-খতিব মুফতি ফয়জুল্লাহ আমানের হাতে ইসলাম গ্রহণ করেছেন ২৩ বছর বয়সী এক উজবেক তরুণী। তার ইসলামি নাম রাখা হয়েছে ‘লাইলা’। বৃহস্পতিবার (২০ আগস্ট) নিজের অফিসিয়াল ফেসবুক পেজে এ তথ্য জানান মুফতি ফয়জুল্লাহ আমান। তিনি জানান, হিজাব পরিধান করে শাহাদাহ পাঠের মাধ্যমে ইসলাম গ্রহণ করেন লাইলা। ইসলাম সম্পর্কে তার আগ্রহ ও জানাশোনাও বেশ ভালো। জানা গেছে, কিছুদিন পর একজন মুসলিম যুবকের সঙ্গে তার বিয়ে হওয়ার কথা রয়েছে। তবে বিয়ে তাঁর ইসলাম গ্রহণের কারণ নয়; বরং ইসলামকে বুঝে ও অন্তর থেকে গ্রহণ করেই তিনি মুসলিম হয়েছেন। নতুন মুসলিম বোন লাইলার ঈমান ও ভবিষ্যৎ জীবনের জন্য দোয়া করেছেন মুফতি ফয়জুল্লাহ আমান। #islam #muslim #IslamicNews #somoytv

ইউক্রেনের রাজধানী কিয়েভে রাশিয়ার ব্যালিস্টিক ক্ষেপণাস্ত্রের হামলায় অন্তত ১২ জন নিহত হয়েছে। বৃহস্পতিবার (২০ আগস্ট) ভোর রাতের এ হামলায় আরও ৩০ জনের বেশি আহত, বহু ভবন ও বিদ্যুৎ সরবরাহ ব্যবস্থা ক্ষতিগ্রস্ত হয়েছে বলে জানিয়েছে কিয়েভ কর্তৃপক্ষ। কিয়েভের মেয়র ভিতালি ক্লিচকো জানান, নগরীর সলোমিয়ানস্কি এলাকায় ৯তলা একটি আবাসিক ব্লক ধ্বংস হয়ে গেছে, এর ওপরের তলাগুলোতে আগুন ধরে যায়, আর সেখানে সাতজনের মৃত্যু হয়। তিনি শুক্রবার (২১ আগস্ট) এক দিনের শোক পালনের আহ্বান জানিয়েছেন। খবর রয়টার্সের। হামলায় কিয়েভের আরও দুটি এলাকা ক্ষতিগ্রস্ত হয়েছে বলে টেলিগ্রাম অ্যাপে ক্লিচকো জানিয়েছেন। এ এলাকাগুলোতে বিভিন্ন স্থাপনা, গুদাম, একটি স্কুল ও একটি শিশু হাসপাতালে আঘাত লেগেছে। বিদ্যুৎ কোম্পানি ডিটিইকে জানায়, হামলার পর প্রায় ৯০ হাজার বাড়ি বিদ্যুৎবিহীন হয়ে পড়ে, তবে এর মধ্যে তারা অর্ধেকের বেশি বাড়ির বিদ্যুৎ সরবরাহ সচল করেছে। #InternationalNews #news #somoytv

Dholavira, one of the finest urban centres of the Sindhu-Saraswati Civilization, has yielded what is regarded as the largest known stone sculpture from the entire civilization spread across the northwestern part of the Indian Subcontinent. Found during the excavations near the Eastern Gate of the Castle, this large sculpture is more than just an artefact. It stands as living evidence of a sophisticated artistic tradition of stone sculpting that began over 4,500 years ago and has continued unbroken in India. From such monumental works of the Indus-Saraswati era to the modern craft of stone sculpting, India has preserved and carried forward this civilizational thread. Dholavira does not merely preserve the past, it affirms that the creative genius of the Sindhu-Saraswati Civilization continues to beat throughout India. #LivingContinuity #SindhuSaraswati #IndusValley #Indus #IndusValleyCivilization

In his recent article in the @htTweets, @SomitDasgupta, flags the issue of lack of storage capacity in India, be it batteries or pumped storage. Dasgupta argues that solar capacity has exceeded 162 GW and the combined generation from renewable capacity and conventional capacity is, at times, exceeding the demand during solar hours. This is despite the fact that coal based generators may be operating at their technical minimum, meaning going down any further will only damage the machines. Consequently, solar generators are being asked to back down, disturbing their economics. Dasgupta adds that had storage been available, the excess daytime power could be used to charge the batteries and also to pump water from the lower reservoir to the higher reservoir in pump storage plants. There seems to be no possibility of immediate relief since the completion of ongoing storage schemes is doubtful due to non-remunerative tariffs arrived at through competitive bidding. اسعد حسن الشیبانی، وزیر امور خارجه سوریه، در یک سفر رسمی وارد اسلام‌آباد، پایتخت پاکستان، شده است. این نخستین سفر یک وزیر امور خارجه سوریه به پاکستان در نزدیک به دو دهه گذشته دانسته می‌شود. قرار است الشیبانی با مقام‌های پاکستانی درباره روابط دوجانبه، همکاری‌های اقتصادی و راه‌های گسترش روابط در بخش‌های مختلف گفت‌وگو کند. این سفر در حالی انجام می‌شود که دو کشور برای تقویت مناسبات دیپلوماتیک و گسترش همکاری‌های منطقه‌ای تلاش دارند. #پاکستان #سوریه #اسلام_آباد #Pakistan #Syria #Islamabad Video

سخنگوی وزارت مخابرات و تکنالوژی معلوماتی امارت‌اسلامی می‌گوید که قرارداد ساخت ۳۱ آنتن مخابراتی به ارزش بیش از ۲۶۹ میلیون افغانی با یکی از شرکت‌های مخابراتی خصوصی امضا شده است. به گفته عنایت‌الله الکوزی، این آنتن‌ها در ۱۳ ولسوالی ولایت‌های قندهار، پکتیکا، هلمند و زابل، به‌ویژه در مناطق دوردست و در امتداد خط فرضی، ساخته خواهند شد. او افزوده است که تاکنون در چارچوب پروژه یازدهم صندوق توسعه مخابرات، قرارداد ساخت ۵۰ آنتن مخابراتی امضا شده است. #طلوع‌نیوز

جان آیلیف، رییس برنامه جهانی خوراک در افغانستان، هشدار داده است که کودکان در افغانستان در نتیجه کاهش کمک‌های بشردوستانه جان می‌دهند و احتمال افزایش مرگ‌ومیر کودکان در ماه‌های آینده وجود دارد. آقای آیلیف در مطلبی که در روزنامه بریتانیایی "Prospect" منتشر شده، نوشته است که افغانستان با سطح بالای سوءتغذیه و گرسنگی روبه‌رو است و بیش از ۱۲ میلیون نفر با گرسنگی حاد دست‌وپنجه نرم می‌کنند. به گفته او، برنامه جهانی خوراک در افغانستان اکنون تنها ۱۲ درصد بودجه مورد نیاز خود را دریافت کرده و کاهش منابع مالی سبب توقف برخی برنامه‌های نجات‌بخش، از جمله برنامه جلوگیری از قحطی، شده است. #طلوع‌نیوز

The IAEA has been informed that the 330 kV Ferosplavna-1 power line at the Zaporizhzhya NPP – the plant’s only remaining off-site power line - was disconnected at 00:44 local time today resulting in a new loss of off-site power. The location of the damage to the line was preliminarily assessed to be on the northern bank of the Dnipro River. An attempt to reconnect the line manually was unsuccessful and, due to ongoing military activity, technicians are currently unable to determine the cause of the outage. Emergency diesel generators automatically started up to power the plants vital safety systems. The IAEA team at the plant continues to assess the situation. Each loss of off-site power underscores the extremely fragile nuclear safety and security situation at the ZNPP, said DG @rafaelmgrossi, repeating his call for maximum restraint and protection of the plant’s external power supply.

Fifty years ago, ASEAN turned a shared aspiration for peace into a lasting commitment. Signed in 1976, the Treaty of Amity and Cooperation in Southeast Asia (TAC) established principles of mutual respect, non-interference, peaceful settlement of disputes, renunciation of the threat or use of force, and effective cooperation. What began as an agreement among ASEAN’s founding members gradually grew alongside the region. As ASEAN expanded, all eleven ASEAN Member States came together under the TAC's principles, while partners from beyond Southeast Asia also joined this commitment to peaceful relations and cooperation. Today, as ASEAN commemorates the 50th Anniversary of the TAC, the Treaty reflects how a regional commitment made five decades ago has grown into a framework connecting ASEAN with partners around the world. At its heart remains a simple belief: lasting peace begins with dialogue, mutual respect, and cooperation. #ASEAN59 #TAC50 #NavigatingOurFutureTogether Video

250,000 books. That is how many my Ukrainian publisher, Knygolove knigolove.ua/ lost on 19 July after three Russian Iskander missiles struck the warehouse outside Kyiv. Among them were my books, too. This is war, and war inevitably brings human and material losses. But when books burn, it is not just paper that burns. Culture, memory, and identity burn with them. So does a nation’s right to grow and shape its own future. That is why burning books has always meant far more than destroying merchandise. I have waived my royalties for the next year to help support my publisher. I encourage you to buy Ukrainian books—as a gesture of solidarity with Ukrainians fighting, among other things, for the right to read books in their own language. Books survive as long as there are people to print them and people to read them.

Con el traspaso de la Presidencia Pro Tempore de Paraguay a Uruguay, comenzó una nueva etapa de trabajo de la Reunión de Altas Autoridades sobre Derechos Humanos del MERCOSUR (RAADDHH). Luego del trabajo desarrollado durante el primer semestre bajo la Presidencia Pro Tempore del Paraguay, Uruguay asumió la conducción de la RAADDHH para el segundo semestre de 2026, con una agenda orientada a fortalecer el diálogo político, la cooperación y la construcción de consensos regionales en materia de Derechos Humanos. Durante la apertura, la Secretaria de Derechos Humanos del Uruguay, Iliana da Silva, destacó especialmente el papel del Instituto de Políticas Públicas de Derechos Humanos del MERCOSUR (IPPDDHH) y reafirmó el compromiso de su país con su consolidación y fortalecimiento: “Queremos subrayar la importancia del Instituto de Políticas Públicas de Derechos Humanos del MERCOSUR, el IPPDDHH, como un actor fundamental para el fortalecimiento de nuestras políticas regionales. También queremos reafirmar nuestro compromiso con su consolidación y fortalecerlo, y destacar el valioso aporte que realiza en la promoción y protección de los Derechos Humanos en el proceso de integración.” Entre las prioridades planteadas para esta nueva etapa se encuentra la salud mental como eje prioritario y transversal, con el objetivo de promover respuestas articuladas e integrales por parte de entre los Estados Partes. 🔗Más información aquí: bit.ly/4gGOhUw

রিয়াল মাদ্রিদের কিংবদন্তি ব্রাজিলিয়ান ফুটবলার রবার্তো কার্লোস ইসলাম গ্রহণ করেছেন, সম্প্রতি এমন খবর ছড়িয়ে পড়ে। তবে এ খবরকে সরাসরি ‘অসত্য’ বলে দাবি করেছেন তিনি। তুরস্কের কয়েকটি সংবাদমাধ্যমে বলা হয়, মরক্কোর নাগরিক সুহাইলা আল-তাহিরিকে বিয়ের পর প্রায় চার সপ্তাহ আগে ব্রাজিলের মুসলিম ব্যক্তিত্ব শায়খ জিহাদ হামাদার কাছে শাহাদাহ পাঠ করে ইসলাম গ্রহণ করেন কার্লোস। তুরস্কের সংসদ সদস্য আলি শাহিনের একটি পোস্টের পর এ দাবি আরও জোরালো হয়। তবে সৌদি সংবাদমাধ্যম ওকাজ-কে দেওয়া সাক্ষাৎকারে কার্লোস বলেন, ‘ইসলামের প্রতি আমার সর্বোচ্চ শ্রদ্ধা রয়েছে। আমার স্ত্রীকে নামাজ পড়তে দেখা খুবই সুন্দর বিষয়। তবে আমার ইসলাম গ্রহণ নিয়ে যে গুজব ছড়িয়েছে, তা সত্য নয়।’ বিয়ের অনুষ্ঠান নিয়ে তিনি জানান, ‘পরিবারের ক্যাথলিক সদস্যদের বিশ্বাস এবং তার স্ত্রী ও মুসলিম বন্ধুদের বিশ্বাস, উভয়ের প্রতি সম্মান রেখেই আলাদাভাবে অনুষ্ঠান আয়োজন করা হয়েছিল। সূত্র: ওকাজের বরাতে দ্য গোল #football #SportsNews #Sports #somoytv

केंद्रीय गृह मंत्री अमित शाह ने वंदे मातरम् पर कांग्रेस के CWC प्रस्ताव पर कहा, "कल कांग्रेस पार्टी की कार्यसमिति ने एक आश्चर्यजनक और देशविरोधी फैसला लिया है। उन्होंने अपनी पार्टी के 1937 के प्रस्ताव को फॉलो करते हुए वंदे मातरम् गीत के 2 ही छंद गाने का फैसला किया है। मैं पूरे देश को याद दिलाना चाहता हूं कि 1937 में कांग्रेस पार्टी ने मुस्लिम तुष्टीकरण के लिए वंदे मातरम् के 2 टुकड़े करके देश के विभाजन की नींव डाली थी जिसके बाद 2 राष्ट्र के सिद्धांत को ताकत मिली थी। देश का विभाजन हुआ और पाकिस्तान का जन्म हुआ। जब उस ऐतिहासिक गलती को मोदी सरकार ने सुधारकर और पूरा गीत गाकर राष्ट्रीय एकात्मता को फिर एक बार सुदृढ़ करने का प्रयास किया है। हमने सभी सरकारी फंक्शन में इसे पूरा गाने के निर्णय को कानूनी जामा भी पहनाया है। इसकी अवहेलना का कांग्रेस ने निर्णय किया है। कांग्रेस का यह निर्णय इनकी घोर तुष्टीकरण की नीति की पुष्टि करता है। वोट बैंक के तुष्टीकरण के लिए इन्होंने स्वर्गीय बंकिम बाबू के अमर कृति का न केवल अपमान किया है बल्कि लाखों शहीदों का अपमान किया है जो देश की आजादी का नारा लगाते हुए फांसी पर चढ़ गए थे और जिन्होंने कई साल जेल में काटे थे। आज कांग्रेस पार्टी अपने 1937 के प्रस्ताव को तो मान रही है लेकिन संसद द्वारा बनाए गए कानून को नकार रही है। मुझे हैरानी है कि राहुल गांधी के नेतृत्व में कांग्रेस पार्टी एक बार फिर तुष्टिकरण की राजनीति को आगे बढ़ा रही है। देश पहले भी 'वंदे मातरम' को दो हिस्सों में बंटने देने की गलती कर चुका है और हमने इसके नतीजे भुगते हैं। अब देश को कांग्रेस पार्टी के इस फ़ैसले के ख़िलाफ़ एकजुट होना चाहिए और कहना चाहिए कि उनकी तुष्टिकरण की राजनीति अब नहीं चलेगी। भाजपा कांग्रेस पार्टी के इस फ़ैसले की निंदा करती है। #Congress #VandeMatram #Politics #AmitShah #BJP #ZeeNews @AmitShah

The six Pakistani sailors injured in the recent Houthi attack on a Tanzanian-flagged commercial vessel have safely returned to Pakistan, while the mortal remains of the two Pakistani sailors who tragically lost their lives have also been repatriated. All relevant stakeholders have been directed to ensure their safe, dignified and expeditious repatriation. I commend the Consulate General of Pakistan in Jeddah and our Embassy in Riyadh for their prompt and dedicated efforts in facilitating the return of the injured and repatriation of the bodies from Yemen and onward travel to Pakistan, in the absence of a Pakistani diplomatic mission in Yemen. I also appreciate the efforts of all relevant stakeholders, including the FIA, in facilitating their smooth arrival and onward arrangements in Pakistan. I deeply appreciate the cooperation extended by the Saudi Ministry of Foreign Affairs, including the medical assistance and arrangements provided in Jeddah. Pakistan condemns the attack in the strongest terms and reiterates that the safety and security of seafarers must be ensured at all times. We remain committed to extending all possible assistance to the injured sailors and the bereaved families.

উত্তম জীবনসঙ্গী পার্থিব জীবনকে আনন্দময় করে তুলে। উত্তম জীবনসঙ্গী পাওয়া প্রতিটি পুরুষের জীবনের অন্যতম চাওয়া। আধুনিক রঙিন এ সময়ে একজন উত্তম জীবনসঙ্গীই একজন পুরুষের ঈমান, আমল রক্ষার অন্যতম মাধ্যম। বিয়ের মাধ্যমে নারী-পুরুষের নিঃসঙ্গতা ও একাকিত্ব দূর হয়। হাদিসে বিয়েকে ঈমানের পূর্ণতা বলা হয়েছে। সৃষ্টিগতভাবেই নারী-পুরুষ একে অপরের পরিপূরক। নারী ছাড়া পুরুষ এবং পুরুষ ছাড়া নারীর জীবন অসম্পূর্ণ। মহান আল্লাহ হযরত আদম (আ.) কে সৃষ্টি করার পর হযরত হাওয়া (আ.) কে তার জীবন সাথি হিসেবে সৃষ্টি করেন। তাদের বিয়ের মাধ্যমে ভালোবাসার বন্ধনে আবদ্ধ করে দেন। সেই ধারাবাহিকতা এখনো পৃথিবীতে চলমান। উত্তম জীবনসঙ্গী লাভের দোয়া পবিত্র কুরআনে হযরত মুসা (আ.)-এর কাহিনী বর্ণিত হয়েছে। সেখানে হযরত মুসা (আ.)-এর একটি দোয়াও এসেছে। যে দোয়া পড়ার পর মহান আল্লাহ তার জন্য থাকা-খাওয়ার ব্যবস্থা করেছেন। তার আশ্রয়ের পাশাপাশি উত্তম জীবন সঙ্গিনীর ব্যবস্থাও করে দিয়েছেন। শিক্ষণীয় সেই দোয়াটি হলো- رَبِّ اِنِّیۡ لِمَاۤ اَنۡزَلۡتَ اِلَیَّ مِنۡ خَیۡرٍ فَقِیۡرٌ উচ্চারণ: রব্বি ইন্নি লিমা আনযালতা ইলাইয়া মিন খাইরিন ফাকির। অর্থ: হে আমার রব, তুমি আমার প্রতি যে অনুগ্রহ পাঠাবে, আমি তার মুখাপেক্ষী। (সুরা আল-কাসাস, আয়াত : ২৪) মহান আল্লাহ চোখ শীতলকারী স্ত্রী ও সন্তানের জন্য পবিত্র কুরআনে বর্ণিত দোয়াটি শিখিয়ে দিয়েছেন। رَبَّنَا هَبۡ لَنَا مِنۡ اَزۡوَاجِنَا وَ ذُرِّیّٰتِنَا قُرَّۃَ اَعۡیُنٍ وَّ اجۡعَلۡنَا لِلۡمُتَّقِیۡنَ اِمَامًا উচ্চারণ: রব্বানা হাবলানা মিন আযওয়াজিনা ওয়া যুররিইয়্যাতিনা কুররতা আইয়ুনিও ওয়াজআলনা লিল মুত্তাকীনা ইমামা। অর্থ: হে আমাদের প্রতিপালক! আপনি আমাদের এমন স্ত্রী ও সন্তান দান করুন। যারা আমাদের চোখ জুড়িয়ে দেয় আর আমাদেরকে (পুরুষদেরকে) মুত্তাকি লোকদের নেতা বানিয়ে দিন। (সুরা ফোরকান, আয়াত : ৭৪)

In this episode of All Things Policy, Gopal Tomar speaks to Dr Dheeraj Dwarakanath about what it would take for India to build a sovereign AI ecosystem on its own terms. They look beyond the hardware to understand where India's real bottlenecks and strengths lie, from electricity, data centres and semiconductor manufacturing to talent, research, multilingual AI and digital public infrastructure. They also examine whether India should compete with the US and China on their terms, or instead build an AI system focused on scale, affordability, delivery and the needs of its billion-plus people. The Milky Way and the Altair and Vega stars on both sides are pictured in Jiamusi City of northeast China's Heilongjiang Province. Known as the Chinese version of the Valentine's Day💕, the Qixi Festival is celebrated on the seventh day of the seventh month on the Chinese lunar calendar. The stars Altair and Vega, regarded as Niu Lang and Zhi Nyu, were beloved couple in the legend who were separated to opposite sides of the Milky Way. Moved by their plight, magpies intervened, creating the bridge with their wings on the seventh night of the seventh month of China's lunar calendar, allowing the couple to reunite for just one day each year. (Source: Xinhua)

З ночі тривають роботи наших екстрених служб на місцях російських влучань. Масований був удар – росіяни довго готувалися і комбінували балістику різних типів, крилаті ракети й дрони так, щоб якомога сильніше пошкодити цивільну інфраструктуру. Є руйнування в Києві та області, на Одещині та Чернігівщині. У столиці пошкоджено житлові будинки, зокрема багатоповерхівку, де зруйнували верхні поверхи, також дитячу лікарню та школу. Аварійно-рятувальні роботи продовжуються. Станом на зараз відомо, що цей російський удар забрав життя 12 людей у Києві, є загибла людина в області. Співчуття всім рідним та близьким. Ще близько 40 людей поранені. На Одещині ворог атакував дронами пункт пропуску на кордоні з Молдовою, на Чернігівщині – газову інфраструктуру. Дякую всім рятувальникам, медикам, поліцейським і комунальникам, які з перших хвилин допомагають людям. На жаль, в той час як Москва вкладається у балістику та ескалацію, не завжди є потрібна реакція світу на такі удари. І поки в України буде недостатньо антибалістики, серйозно думати про мир Росія не буде. Ми робимо все, щоб захист був, і щодня йде робота над програмою FREYJA. Але перехоплювачі до «петріотів» поки що не замінити, і вони потрібні щодня. Кожна додаткова ракета зберігає життя наших людей. Я дякую всім, хто це розуміє, шукає і знаходить можливості допомогти.

Emergency crews have been working at the sites of Russian strikes since overnight. It was a massive attack – the Russians had been preparing for a long time, combining different types of ballistic missiles, cruise missiles, and drones, aiming to cause as much damage as possible to civilian infrastructure. There is destruction in Kyiv and the region, as well as in the Odesa and Chernihiv regions. In the capital, residential buildings were damaged, including a high-rise whose upper floors were destroyed, as well as a children’s hospital and a school. Emergency response and rescue operations are ongoing. As of now, we know that this Russian strike has claimed the lives of 12 people in Kyiv, with one person killed in the region. My condolences to all the families and loved ones. Around 40 more people were injured. In the Odesa region, the enemy carried out a drone attack on a border crossing with Moldova; in the Chernihiv region, it targeted gas infrastructure. I thank all the rescuers, medics, police officers, and utility workers who have been helping people from the first moments. Unfortunately, while Moscow is investing in ballistic missiles and escalation, such strikes do not always receive the response they should from the world. And as long as Ukraine does not have enough anti-ballistic defense, Russia will not consider peace seriously. We are doing everything to ensure we have that protection, and work on the FREYJA program continues every day. But Patriot interceptors cannot yet be replaced, and we need them every day. Every additional missile saves the lives of our people. I thank everyone who understands this and is looking for and finding ways to help.

Subsea cables are the fibre-optic networks laid across the ocean floor that carry approximately 95% of all intercontinental digital communications, serving as the essential, yet often invisible, backbone of the modern global internet. In India, the subsea cable ecosystem is constrained by regulatory gaps, procurement hurdles, and structural commercial barriers, resulting in significant vulnerabilities in the nation’s digital connectivity. In this episode of All Things Policy, Anisree Suresh (@AnisreeSuresh) and Anwesha Sen (@Anwxsha) explore these vulnerabilities and discuss ways to mitigate the same. This is despite the fact that coal based generators may be operating at their technical minimum, meaning going down any further will only damage the machines. Consequently, solar generators are being asked to back down, disturbing their economics. Dasgupta adds that had storage been available, the excess daytime power could be used to charge the batteries and also to pump water from the lower reservoir to the higher reservoir in pump storage plants. There seems to be no possibility of immediate relief since the completion of ongoing storage schemes is doubtful due to non-remunerative tariffs arrived at through competitive bidding. Try @Grok @Bot DJ (@congressdj) I am not a coder. I don’t work with CRM or play with spreadsheets. I’m about as removed from a “workflow” in my job as a kid flying a kite. I don’t really use AI beyond a super-Google level. So when I say Grok Bot is ABSOLUTELY GAME CHANGING, I don’t mean a better search tool. I mean it has fundamentally changed how I go about everything. And it did this in just a few hours. Let me explain. During the install, it asked if I wanted to connect it to several dozen programs. I don’t use a single one of them. So I thought, “Well, I’m not gonna get a lot of use out of this.” But I kept going. Then it asked if it could connect to my Gmail. I said yes. And that’s where the jaw-dropping began. It immediately figured out my life. It saw 40,000 emails and got a pretty good picture of me. So I asked it to do my taxes. It found all the docs needed in my email and did my taxes. I asked it to find first-class award tickets to Japan. It scoured the internet and logged into my airline accounts (with permission) and found 3 tickets to Japan in first class for 60K points. It would have booked them, but I’m still not sure of the dates I need so I stopped it. I created a few agents. One gives me an hourly political update based on key topics I need for work. One is cleaning up my Gmail inbox and organizing it. One is saving me money in my taxes. One makes sure it always checks with me on key decisions (like deleting an email). It’s absolutely insane. In this episode of the All Things Policy podcast, Kavya Rai and Abhishek Kadiyala (@AbhishekSocials) examine India's 2026 amendments to the Foreign Contribution Regulation Act and why a domestic funding law has drawn attention in Washington. The conversation frames the issue as a collision between Indian regulatory sovereignty and the rising force of religious-freedom politics in the United States. It traces the money at stake, from American donors to Indian recipients, and situates the debate within USCIRF hearings, Congressional interest, and the evangelical turn in US politics. The episode argues that while the executive has shown limited appetite for action, having moved only against Nigeria, the FCRA question retains real nuisance value as a Congressional and electoral lever. It ultimately asks whether this issue becomes an active irritant in India-US ties, or remains a low-grade friction ahead of the midterms. Після цього темпи просування спали, адже Сили Оборони стали від Великої Новосілки до Вугледару, а кацап стирався у штурмах ДонУРу (Донецького укріпленого району). Натомість "друга армія світу" за майже аналогічний період дійшла від Донецька до Покровська. Яким чином американські партнери вважають такий "черепаховий наступ" козирем — зрозуміти складно. Хоча, звісно, і ми не в змозі за нинішньої конфігурації сил звільнити всі міжнародно визнані території. OPENAI DEJA DE ENTRENAR NUEVOS MODELOS DE IA DEBIDO A LOS RIESGOS DE CIBERSEGURIDAD | Por Renzo Gonzales OpenAI ha decidido suspender el desarrollo de nuevos modelos de inteligencia artificial tras detectar riesgos de ciberseguridad que superan sus sistemas de control actuales. En un comunicado oficial publicado en su blog, la empresa explicó que los modelos más avanzados representan desafíos de seguridad cada vez mayores. “A medida que los modelos ganan capacidad, los riesgos asociados a su desarrollo y prueba interna también crecen”, señaló la firma. La organización admitió que su próximo modelo, denominado Astra, podría alcanzar el umbral de “capacidades críticas de ciberseguridad”, una alerta interna que deriva en la suspensión temporal de los trabajos de investigación y entrenamiento. تا امروز بر هیچ‌کسی پوشیده نیست که پشت ۴۰ سال جنگی که به نام دین در افغانستان رخ داده، نزاع بر سر قدرت، هویت قومی و انحصار فرمانروایی قرار داشته است. گروه‌های مدعی حاکمیت، از خدا، دین، وطن، انقلاب و نجات مردم به‌عنوان شعارهای اصلی رفتارشان سود برده‌اند تا مرگ میلیونی مردم را از حادثه‌ای بیهوده به مأموریتی بزرگ الهی، جهت برپایی حاکمیت الله و رسیدن به حوران بهشتی، تبدیل کنند. قدرت عریان به‌تنهایی توانایی بسیج مردم برای مرگ را ندارد و همین‌جاست که دین، در گستره‌ی هستی انسان افغانستانی، در درون این چرخه‌ی منازعات، تنها به‌عنوان یک عقیده‌ی شخصی باقی نماند و به زبان قدرت و زور تبدیل شد؛ زوری که خود را به حق و حقیقت آسمانی پیوند می‌دهد، اطاعت بی‌چون‌وچرا را به فضیلت شرعی و جنگ را به وظیفه‌ای اجباری تفسیر می‌نماید. از آن‌جایی که تفنگ، ایجاد وحشت و کشتار برای دوام حکومت کافی نیست، تلاش حاکمیت‌ها و گروه‌های سیاسی ما این بوده است تا مردم فرمان او را با این احساس بپذیرند که اطاعتشان مطابق دستور شریعت الهی و اخلاقی است. هرچه دولت ضعیف‌تر، قانون بی‌اعتبارتر و نهادهای عمومی بی‌اعتمادتر باشند، قدرت بیشتر به چیزی بیرون از خود پناه می‌برد که در افغانستان، این پناهگاه اغلب اسلام و شریعت محمدی و گاه هم هژمون قبیله بوده است. از آغاز سال‌های ۱۷۴۷ تا امروز، مشروعیت سیاسی در افغانستان مدام آواره بوده و مکان ثابتی نداشته است. این مشروعیت بی‌خانمان، زمانی در سلطنت جست‌وجو شده، زمانی در گلیم وارداتی انقلاب کارگری، گاهی در گرایشات فرسوده‌ی قومی، در برهه‌هایی در وجود مفهوم بی‌بار جهاد و سرانجام در تابوت بی‌جنازه‌ی انتخابات و شاکله‌ی امارت. تاریخ ما گواه است که هیچ‌یک از این منابع نتوانسته‌اند بنای مشترک و مورد اعتماد همه را بیافرینند. در این دیار، دولت بارها و بارها فروریخته، قانون نداشته باشد، راه پیوند دادن آن به خدا و شریعت برای حاکم کوتاه‌تر می‌شود. مشکل تاریخی ما این است که دستگاه قدرت و حاکمیت همیشه از دین به‌عنوان ابزار تحکیم خود استفاده کرده و الگوی تاریخی حاکمیت این The Air Force has now placed Maj. Jason Watson in pretrial confinement following his public calls for President Donald J. Trump’s impeachment. Watson was previously arrested on July 1st after delivering a speech on the U.S. Capitol steps calling for the impeachment of President Trump while in uniform. He was not formally charged by the military over that demonstration, although wearing a uniform while participating in political activity is prohibited by military regulations. He was detained again on Aug. 18, one day after criticizing Trump in a CNN interview. According to his attorney, Watson had informed his chain of command that he would no longer wear his uniform and was arrested after refusing an order to put it back on. The Air Force says there is probable cause supporting allegations of “continued misconduct,” but Watson has not yet been formally charged. His attorney expects potential charges under Article 88, which prohibits contemptuous words against certain senior government officials, or Article 92 for failure to obey an order. در شش‌ ماه نخست سال ۲۰۲۶، تیم دیدبان حقوق زنان افغانستان موفق به مستندسازی ۲۲۵ مورد نقض جدی حقوق زنان و دختران شده است. این موارد شامل ۵۳ قتل و اقدام به قتل، ۷۹ مورد بازداشت خودسرانه و ناپدیدسازی اجباری، هفت مورد خودکشی، ده‌ها مورد شلاق، خشونت فیزیکی و سایر اشکال خشونت ساختاری است. این ارقام تنها حداقل موارد قابل ثبت بوده و نباید به‌عنوان ابعاد واقعی بحران تلقی شوند. تحلیل یافته‌های ما نشان می‌دهد که خشونت علیه زنان در افغانستان دیگر ماهیتی پراکنده ندارد، بلکه از الگوی مشخصی پیروی می‌کند. از میان ۵۳ مورد قتل مستندشده، ۱۷ مورد قتل‌های خانوادگی، نُه مورد قتل‌های ناموسی و ۲۷ مورد قتل‌های هدفمند بوده‌اند. بسیاری از قربانیان را زنان معترض، فعالان مدنی، آموزگاران، خبرنگاران، کارمندان پیشین دولت و زنانی تشکیل می‌دهند که در برابر سیاست‌های تبعیض‌آمیز مقاومت کرده‌اند. این روند نشان می‌دهد که خشونت نه‌تنها برای کنترل زنان، بلکه برای حذف آگاهانه‌ی زنان فعال از عرصه‌ی عمومی به‌کار گرفته می‌شود. در همین دوره، ۷۹ مورد بازداشت خودسرانه و ناپدیدسازی اجباری زنان و دختران نیز ثبت شده است. این بازداشت‌ها عمدتا به‌دلیل نوع پوشش، حضور در اماکن عمومی، فعالیت مدنی یا اعتراضات صورت گرفته و در بسیاری از موارد خانواده‌ها از محل نگهداری یا سرنوشت بازداشت‌شدگان بی‌اطلاع بوده‌اند. کابل و هرات بیشترین آمار موارد ثبت‌شده را داشته‌اند و تفتیش تلفن‌های همراه، کنترل ارتباطات دیجیتال و گسترش ایست‌های بازرسی، به ابزارهای دائمی کنترل زنان تبدیل شده است. یافته‌های آماری این گزارش همچنین نشان می‌دهد که ۷.۸۵ درصد قربانیان در گروه سنی ۱۸ تا ۳۴ سال قرار دارند؛ نسلی که در دودهه‌ی گذشته به آموزش، دانشگاه، اشتغال و مشارکت اجتماعی دسترسی داشته و امروز بیش از هر گروه دیگری هدف حذف سیستماتیک قرار گرفته است. تمرکز نزدیک به نیمی از موارد ثبت‌شده در کابل و هرات نیز بیانگر آن است که شهرهای بزرگ، به‌دلیل حضور پررنگ‌تر زنان در عرصه‌ی عمومی، به کانون اصلی نظارت، کنترل و سرکوب تبدیل شده‌اند. بیشتر بخوانید: etilaatroz.com/259444

300+ KM AWAY. Pakistan thought its aircraft was safe deep inside its own airspace. It wasn’t. During Operation Sindoor, India’s S-400 reportedly destroyed a Pakistani high-value airborne target at a range exceeding 300 km, a surface-to-air engagement the IAF described as the longest ever recorded. Think about what that means. The IAF didn’t need to cross the border. The target didn’t need to approach India. From hundreds of kilometres away, India’s air-defence network could reach deep into the battlespace. For Pakistan, the message was brutal: Distance was no longer protection. Operation Sindoor didn’t just redraw the battlefield. It expanded it. 🇮🇳

Pakistan may have celebrated kills that were never kills. During Operation Sindoor, the IAF reportedly turned deception itself into a weapon. Rafale towed decoys, electronic warfare and unmanned false targets could create convincing tracks, forcing Pakistani radars and missiles to chase ghosts while the real strike package continued its mission. And there was a second trap: every air-defence radar that lit up to engage those decoys risked giving away its own position. That’s what makes modern air warfare fascinating. You detect a target. You lock it. You fire. You see the missile detonate. You celebrate a kill. Except the “fighter” you just killed may never have been a fighter at all. 🇮🇳

Completely agree with @RushDoshi & Campbell. Rush Doshi (@RushDoshi) NEW in @ForeignAffairs: For this issue's cover, Kurt Campbell and I challenge the new fatalism about American alliances. We argue: 1️⃣ The alliances have weathered forgotten shocks at least this serious before, and today's are about Trump, not a permanent new politics. 2️⃣ The threats that built the alliances are intensifying and converging as China and Russia draw together. 3️⃣ Deep economic, technological, and military currents are pulling allies toward Washington faster than they can de-risk away. The new fatalism risks becoming self-fulfilling. Convinced the alliances cannot be saved, policymakers may stop trying to save them. But the question is not whether the alliances will endure but whether they can evolve into something new — platforms for building allied scale in a world where China, backed by Russia, outscales us all. We think they can. The United States will need to launch a presidential effort to rebuild and refashion the alliance system. It will need to credibly declare that the current damage is the product of personality not enduring policy, repudiate threats against Greenland, and start small with allies. That means modest, defined projects with ad hoc coalitions on the issues of greatest consensus (medicine, minerals, munitions). Quick wins build momentum for more ambitious efforts. And Biden projects like AUKUS and even Trump's effort on critical minerals provide a model. None of this is guaranteed, but neither is it implausible. The United States and its allies have agency. As attention turns to the world after Trump, the debate over the future needs more pragmatism and less despair. Thread below. — http://nitter.perennialte.ch/RushDoshi/status/2090131592802869286#m

President Donald J. Trump has announced what he calls the "MOST CRUSHING ECONOMIC OPERATION EVER TAKEN AGAINST ANY COUNTRY," declaring a campaign of unprecedented economic warfare and isolation against Iran. Trump said the United States will target not only Iran, but any country, financial institution, business, airport or government entity providing Iran with what he describes as a "lifeline." He specifically cited oil smuggling, financial transfers, currency exchanges, ship registries and front companies. The announcement represents a significant shift in rhetoric from the administration's repeated public assertions over the past several months that negotiations with Iran were progressing well and a deal was close. As recently as August 5, Trump said negotiations were "working out quite well," while on July 28 he described discussions with Iran as a "beautiful discussion" and said the door remained open to a deal. Those statements came despite the June Memorandum of Understanding (MOU) ultimately collapsing, the 60 day negotiating window expiring without a broader agreement, and Iran and the United States remaining sharply divided over the Strait of Hormuz, sanctions and the U.S. military presence in the region. Today's announcement therefore appears to mark another significant turn in the administration's carrot-and stick strategy toward Tehran: Trump is simultaneously declaring Iran to be on the brink of collapse while imposing substantially broader economic pressure intended to force a resolution. Trump also reiterated that Iran will never be permitted to obtain a nuclear weapon.

Five Americans and Ecuador’s intelligence chief, Michele Sensi-Contugi, were killed Wednesday when a helicopter crashed in central Kenya. According to Kenyan authorities, the Eurocopter EC-130 B4 was carrying seven people when it went down near Mount Ololokwe in Samburu County. Sensi-Contugi was traveling with his wife, fashion designer Stephany Sensi, who was also killed. Telemundo executive José Suárez was among the American fatalities. The helicopter was reportedly carrying guests from the luxury safari operator &Beyond and had been traveling from the Loisaba wildlife conservancy toward the Ewaso Ngiro River. The cause of the crash has not been determined. Kenyan Red Cross teams conducted search and recovery operations at the site, which were complicated by difficult terrain and an active fire. Kenya’s Transport Ministry is investigating. The U.S. State Department confirmed the deaths of the five Americans and said the U.S. Embassy was coordinating with Kenyan authorities and providing consular assistance. The Navy has charged a sailor with murder and involuntary manslaughter in connection with the June 6 shooting death of Boatswain’s Mate Seaman Jesse Braswell (picturec below) aboard the aircraft carrier John F. Kennedy (CVN-79). At the time of the shooting, the JFK was docked at Newport News shipbuilding. According to the charge sheet obtained by USNI News, Aviation Boatswain’s Mate Aircraft Handling Airman Apprentice Jayjrion Rodriguez allegedly shot Braswell while the two were serving as part of the ship’s in port security force. Rodriguez is also charged with three specifications each of simple assault with a loaded firearm and reckless endangerment. The charges allege that he pointed a loaded service pistol at three other sailors on separate occasions, once in February and twice in May, before Braswell’s death. Rodriguez was initially placed in pretrial confinement following the June shooting but was released five days later. The Navy formally charged him on July 29. The Virginia medical examiner classified Braswell’s death as a homicide. Naval Criminal Investigative Service (NCIS) remains the lead investigative agency, and an Article 32 preliminary hearing is expected in the coming weeks.

For the first time in U.S. history, the national debt has surpassed $40 trillion. The milestone comes as the federal government has added roughly $2.5 trillion since the beginning of fiscal year 2026 on October 1, 2025. The Congressional Budget Office reports that the government borrowed about $1.8 trillion during the first 10 months of the fiscal year alone. Using the Census Bureau's 2026 population estimate of roughly 342.7 million people, $40 trillion equates to approximately $116,700 in gross federal debt for every U.S. resident. And the cost of servicing that debt is growing: the CBO reported approximately $963 billion in net interest payments during the first 10 months of FY2026, or more than $3 billion per day.

What’s the difference between a rock and a mineral? 🪨 We’ve all picked up an interesting rock at some point, but what looks like a single rock may be made up of several different minerals. Think of minerals as the pieces, and rocks as the puzzle they make. A mineral is a naturally occurring, non-living, solid substance with its own unique chemical makeup and structure. Common minerals include quartz, feldspar, mica, olivine, and calcite. A rock, on the other hand, is a mix of one or more minerals bound together. Granite, basalt, limestone, and sandstone are all rocks made up of different mineral combinations. USGS scientists study the mineral content of rocks and map them across the U.S. to understand where valuable mineral deposits might be found, information that helps meet the needs of modern manufacturing, technology, and energy production. Our scientists also study how rocks form and change over time, piecing together the story of our planet's 4.5-billion-year history. Discover more about the rocks and minerals that shape our world and how USGS studies them at ow.ly/iKA550ZzxSA 📸1: Vertical columns of basaltic volcanic rock, like those at Devils Postpile National Monument in California, are formed when think lava flows slowly cool. 📸2: A sample of azurite, the blue mineral, and malachite, the green mineral from Milpillas Mine, Mexico. Both azurite and malachite are copper minerals that were once used as pigments. They serve as good indicators of copper deposits that can be developed. 📸3: Silicon Carbide’s primary commodity is silica, an abrasive. Just as their name implies, abrasives are used to abrade, clean, etch, grind, polish, scour, or otherwise remove material. 📸4: A fluorite mineral set in surrounding rock. Flourspar, the processed form of fluorite, is used directly or indirectly to manufacture products such as aluminum, gasoline, insulating foams, refrigerants, steel, and uranium fuel. Con el traspaso de la Presidencia Pro Tempore de Paraguay a Uruguay, comenzó una nueva etapa de trabajo de la Reunión de Altas Autoridades sobre Derechos Humanos del MERCOSUR (RAADDHH). Luego del trabajo desarrollado durante el primer semestre bajo la Presidencia Pro Tempore del Paraguay, Uruguay asumió la conducción de la RAADDHH para el segundo semestre de 2026, con una agenda orientada a fortalecer el diálogo político, la cooperación y la construcción de consensos regionales en materia de Derechos Humanos. Durante la apertura, la Secretaria de Derechos Humanos del Uruguay, Iliana da Silva, destacó especialmente el papel del Instituto de Políticas Públicas de Derechos Humanos del MERCOSUR (IPPDDHH) y reafirmó el compromiso de su país con su consolidación y fortalecimiento: “Queremos subrayar la importancia del Instituto de Políticas Públicas de Derechos Humanos del MERCOSUR, el IPPDDHH, como un actor fundamental para el fortalecimiento de nuestras políticas regionales. También queremos reafirmar nuestro compromiso con su consolidación y fortalecerlo, y destacar el valioso aporte que realiza en la promoción y protección de los Derechos Humanos en el proceso de integración.” Entre las prioridades planteadas para esta nueva etapa se encuentra la salud mental como eje prioritario y transversal, con el objetivo de promover respuestas articuladas e integrales por parte de entre los Estados Partes. 🔗Más información aquí: bit.ly/4gGOhUw

U.S. and South Korean officials say the changes will preserve the exercise’s essential readiness objectives, while North Korea has condemned the drills as provocative regardless of their reduced size. The Wall Street Journal has reported that Trump’s aides are pushing for a meeting with Kim as early as this fall. The Caribbean Community (CARICOM), with its international development partners, has taken a proactive and anticipatory approach to confront current global challenges, which threaten livelihoods and development in the Region. Appearing recently on the Quick Wins segment of the Social Protection Podcast, Programme Manager, Agricultural and Agro-Industrial Development at the CARICOM Secretariat, Shaun Baugh, highlighted the steps the Region is taking to ensure food security, managing drought, fluctuating energy prices and supply chain disruptions in the face of the ongoing conflict in the Middle East, the projected impact of El Nino, referred to as ‘Super El Nino’, and other global and climate shocks. “We in the Region have what is called a 25 x 25 + 5 food security plan. And what it really seeks to do is to improve our food and nutrition security status. One, trying to reduce our reliance on imports and to improve and transform our food systems. So, what the Region, through our Heads of Government, has done, we have developed what is called a regional response framework or matrix. In other words, it has mapped all the potential scenarios and impacts to be generated from these two conflicts, and we have come up with long-term and short-term as well as medium-term solutions,” Mr. Baugh said during the segment. The Supreme Court has issued nationwide directions to tackle India’s growing solid waste crisis, stressing that citizens, households and institutions must take responsibility for the waste they generate. It directed schools and colleges to introduce theoretical and practical waste management lessons and train students to educate their families about segregation, storage and disposal. The court also ordered an audit and upgrade of waste management infrastructure and directed District Collectors to identify bulk waste generators within six weeks. Non-compliant bulk waste generators could face temporary disconnection of water and electricity until they submit a compliance certificate. Authorities were also asked to act against illegal dumping and monitor garbage accumulation. The court stressed that lasting improvement requires civic responsibility and cannot depend solely on government agencies or sanitation workers. #IndiaTodaySocial #SupremeCourt #WasteManagement #GarbageCrisis

VIDEO | Dutch hockey great Taeke Taekema highlighted the differences between Indian and Dutch hockey cultures, describing Dutch hockey as a passing-oriented game while Indian hockey relies more on speed, flair and individual skill. "The general skill level in India is very high. You can see the flair in Indian culture and Indian athletes bring that flair onto the hockey field. There are a lot of out-of-the-box things Indian players can do that many other players in the world cannot. That's definitely a huge strength. But every strength also comes with a downside. Sometimes it is more difficult for Indian players to stay within a structure and consistently do the simple things well, making five or six simple passes and staying patient. Dutch hockey is traditionally based more on passing, give-and-go movements and short combinations. Indian hockey, by comparison, is more of a running game and relies more on individual skills. For me, the ideal situation is a combination of the two. Never lose the flair. Keep doing the creative, out-of-the-box things that come naturally. But at the same time, stay structured, stick to the basics and execute them well," he said. (Full video available on PTI Videos - ptivideos.com) Video

'कश्मीर भारत का हिस्सा'.... सर्जियो गोर के बयान से PAK को लगी मिर्ची, US राजनयिक को किया तलब भारत में अमेरिकी राजदूत दूत सर्जियो गोर के श्रीनगर दौरे ने पाकिस्तान में खलबली मचा दी है. सर्जियो गोर द्वारा जम्मू-कश्मीर को 'भारत का अभिन्न हिस्सा' बताए जाने से पाकिस्तान तिलमिला गया है. उसने कड़ा विरोध दर्ज कराया है. पाकिस्तान के विदेश मंत्रालय ने इस्लामाबाद में तैनात अमेरिकी उप-मिशन प्रमुख (चार्ज डी'अफेयर्स) को तलब किया और आधिकारिक आपत्ति पत्र (डिमार्श) थमा दिया. दरअसल, 19 अगस्त यानी बुधवार को श्रीनर पहुंचे अमेरिकी राजदूत सर्जियो गोर ने कहा कि 'जम्मू-कश्मीर भारत का अहम हिस्सा है. उन्होंने कहा कि मैं पहली बार इस जगह का दौरा कर रहा हूं, यह खूबसूरत जगह है.' . . पाकिस्तान ने अमेरिकी दूत सर्जियो गोर के इस बयान को तथ्यहीन, गैर-जिम्मेदाराना और अंतरराष्ट्रीय नियमों के खिलाफ बताया है. पाकिस्तान ने कहा कि वह इस बयान को खारिज करता है और उसके मुताबिक कश्मीर का समाधान संयुक्त राष्ट्र सुरक्षा परिषद (UNSC) के प्रस्तावों के तहत ही होना चाहिए. पाकिस्तान के विदेश मंत्रालय का दावा है कि राजदूत का यह बयान अमेरिका की पुरानी नीति और यूएन चार्टर के सिद्धांतों की अनदेखी करता है. पाकिस्तान ने यह भी कहा कि राष्ट्रपति डोनाल्ड ट्रंप द्वारा पहले मध्यस्थता की बात कहे जाने के बाद अब अमेरिका को ऐसे सार्वजनिक बयानों में संयम रखना चाहिए. पाकिस्तान के विदेश मंत्रालय ने दोहराया कि जम्मू-कश्मीर का समाधान संयुक्त राष्ट्र के प्रस्तावों के तहत ही होना चाहिए, पाकिस्तान ने अमेरिका से आग्रह किया है कि वह अपने सार्वजनिक बयानों में कश्मीर की इस स्थिति का ध्यान रखें. बुधवार को भारत में अमेरिकी राजदूत सर्जियो गोर ने श्रीनगर में मुख्यमंत्री उमर अब्दुल्ला से भी मुलाकात की. इस दौरान सर्जियो ने कश्मीर के बेहतर सुरक्षा हालात की तारीफ की. दोनों नेताओं की बातचीत में ट्रैवल एडवाइजरी (यात्रा चेतावनी) का मुद्दा भी उठा. इस पर सर्जियो ने कहा कि केंद्र सरकार, मुख्यमंत्री और स्थानीय प्रशासन ने इलाके को सुरक्षित बनाने के लिए बेहतरीन कदम उठाए हैं, अब अमेरिका अपनी ट्रैवल एडवाइजरी की समीक्षा करेगा और इस पर विचार करेगा कि क्या चेतावनी के स्तर को कम किया जा सकता है. #JammuKashmir #UnitedStates #India #SergioGor #Pakistan

On World Humanitarian Day, WHO Calls for Protection of Health Care On World Humanitarian Day, WHO honours the memory of health workers who lost their lives in the line of duty and recognizes the dedication of those who continue to provide care in challenging and dangerous environments. Attacks on health care remain a critical issue in the occupied Palestinian territory (oPt), continuing to threaten the safety of health workers and patients. This year, up to July 2026, 142 attacks on health care have been recorded across the oPt, resulting in 14 deaths and 77 injuries. In the Gaza Strip, between January and July 2026, a total of 44 attacks on health care were verified. The highest numbers were recorded in February and June, with 10 incidents each, together accounting for almost half of all attacks, followed by May, which recorded 7 incidents. The attacks in February were mostly linked to obstruction of access to health care, including those associated with the resumption of medical evacuations following the reopening of the Rafah Crossing. In June, the most significant incident included the detention of seven Palestine Red Crescent Society (PRCS) ambulance team members. Geographically, Rafah recorded the highest number of attacks, with nearly 50 per cent of all recorded incidents, followed by Khan Younis. In both areas, movement restrictions and access constraints around the so-called ‘yellow line’ contributed to prolonged delays in medical missions, including extended wait for authorization to proceed. In the West Bank, 98 attacks on health care were verified between January and July 2026. July recorded the highest number of attacks, with 37 incidents accounting for nearly 40 per cent of all attacks in the West Bank, followed by March with 15 attacks and April with 13 attacks. Nablus recorded the highest number of attacks with nearly 50 per cent of all attacks, followed by 24 per cent in Ramallah. The attacks happened amid increased settler violence, intensified hostilities, and increased closures of checkpoints and gates severely impeding ambulance movement, which led to significant delays in patient transfers. Notable incidents in July included the death of a four-month-old infant in critical condition after being delayed at the Awarta checkpoint, where ambulance access was reportedly denied. The infant's father was forced to carry the child across the checkpoint on foot, amid the use of tear gas in the area. In another reported incident in July, a woman who was six months pregnant and experiencing severe bleeding was prevented from crossing a checkpoint by ambulance, with the delay in care resulting in the loss of pregnancy. Other incidents in July included a raid on Nablus Specialized Hospital, during which a patient and their companion were detained, and a raid on the Palestine Medical Complex in Ramallah, which resulted in damage to hospital property and to ambulances parked in the hospital courtyard. On World Humanitarian Day, WHO reiterates its call for all for the respect and protection of health workers, patients, health facilities, and medical transport, in accordance with international humanitarian law. Protecting health care means protecting lives, ensuring access to essential services, and preserving the resilience of health systems when they are needed most.

🇵🇰🤝🇵🇹 Chairman Senate Underscores Strong Pakistan-Portugal Ties, Invites Portuguese Investment Ambassador of Portugal to Pakistan, H.E. Paulo Miguel Guedes Dominguez, called on Chairman Senate Syed Yousaf Raza Gilani at his residence in Ministers’ Enclave, Islamabad, today. The meeting discussed bilateral relations, trade and investment, parliamentary cooperation and people-to-people contacts. Chairman Senate Syed Yousaf Raza Gilani said that Pakistan attaches great importance to its longstanding and friendly relations with Portugal and desires to further strengthen bilateral cooperation in trade, investment, agriculture, IT, education, culture and the blue economy. He highlighted the growing bilateral trade and said there was considerable potential to further expand economic relations by exploring new opportunities. He invited Portuguese companies and investors to explore Pakistan’s emerging economic and business potential and forge mutually beneficial partnerships. The Chairman Senate also highlighted the role Inter-parliamentary speaker's conference. He said that ISC is an important platform to promote peace , security and development in the region. The Chairman Senate also appreciated the contribution of the Pakistani community in Portugal, noting that around 50,000 Pakistanis are living and working there. He said the community serves as an important bridge between the two countries and emphasized the need to enhance cooperation in labour and human resource development. Syed Yousaf Raza Gilani expressed hope for the early conclusion of the Agreement on Labour Mobility Partnership, saying it would provide a framework for greater cooperation in this important area. He also stressed the importance of enhanced cooperation between Pakistani and Portuguese universities through student and faculty exchanges and joint research programmes. He appreciated Portugal’s continued support for Pakistan’s GSP Plus status and expressed the hope that high-level exchanges and regular bilateral consultations would further deepen relations between the two countries. Ambassador Paulo Miguel Guedes Dominguez thanked the Chairman Senate for the warm welcome and expressed Portugal’s keen interest in strengthening bilateral relations with Pakistan, particularly in trade, investment and economic cooperation. Reuters reports that the U.S. and South Korea are cutting the duration and scope of the Ulchi Freedom Shield exercise following President Donald J. Trump’s order to Secretary of War Pete Hegseth to substantially reduce U.S. participation. The exercise, which began Aug. 17, will now end Aug. 21 rather than Aug. 27. The allies are also scaling back some field maneuvers, with portions of the planned second phase reportedly being canceled and some live-fire training events either canceled or shifted to simulations. U.S. and South Korean officials say the changes will preserve the exercise’s essential readiness objectives, while North Korea has condemned the drills as provocative regardless of their reduced size. On Sunday, President Trump took to Truth Social to order the reduction citing his “very good relationship” with Kim Jong Un, while Reuters reports that the administration is also seeking to reopen direct diplomacy with Pyongyang. The Wall Street Journal has reported that Trump’s aides are pushing for a meeting with Kim as early as this fall. South Korean officials said they were not informed in advance of President Trump’s order. Source: defensenews.com/news/pentago…

The passing of Asish Banerjee has left me deeply disturbed. He spent much of his life teaching and serving society with dedication, always known for his humble nature and close bond with the people of Rampurhat and Birbhum. What makes this tragedy even more painful is the immense mental and emotional strain he appears to have endured in his final days. As a five-term MLA, former Deputy Speaker and Chairman, Asish Da dedicated himself to bringing development to Rampurhat and undertook a large number of important works for the people. Yet, despite the work he did, he was repeatedly maligned, falsely accused and subjected to relentless pressure. The harassment and mental pressure he faced, despite his long record of public service, should make all of us pause and reflect on the human cost of relentless political hostility. My heartfelt prayers and condolences to his family, loved ones, former students and countless admirers. His absence will be deeply felt, always.

ইরান ও উপসাগরীয় আরব দেশগুলোর মাঝ দিয়ে বয়ে যাওয়া হরমুজ প্রণালীকে সম্প্রতি যুক্তরাষ্ট্রের ভূখণ্ড হিসেবে ঘোষণা করেন দেশটির প্রেসিডেন্ট ডোনাল্ড ট্রাম্প। এর জবাবে যুক্তরাষ্ট্রের অঙ্গরাজ্য ক্যালিফোর্নিয়াকে নিজেদের ‘নতুন ভূখণ্ড’ হিসেবে ঘোষণা করেছে ইরান। ভারতে অবস্থিত ইরানের দূতাবাসের অফিসিয়াল এক্স অ্যাকাউন্ট থেকে বুধবার (১৯ আগস্ট) একটি টুইট করা হয়েছে। সেখানে ক্যালিফোর্নিয়াকে নীল রঙ দিয়ে চিহ্নিত করে লেখা হয়েছে, “ইসলামিক প্রজাতন্ত্র ইরানের নতুন ভূখণ্ড।” এর আগে ট্রাম্প তার ট্রুথ সোশ্যাল অ্যাকাউন্টে একটি মানচিত্র প্রকাশ করেন। সেখানে হরমুজের ওপর লেখা হয়েছে ‘যুক্তরাষ্ট্রের নতুন ভূখণ্ড’। ট্রাম্প ঘোষণা দিয়েছিলেন, হরমুজকে তিনি মার্কিন ভূখণ্ড হিসেবে ঘোষণা দেবেন। তার পোস্টটি হোয়াইট হাউজের অফিসিয়াল অ্যাকাউন্টেও শেয়ার করা হয়। ট্রাম্পের এমন পোস্টের পর এর তীব্র নিন্দা জানান ইরানের উপপররাষ্ট্রমন্ত্রী কাজেম ঘারিবাবাদি। তিনি মার্কিন প্রেসিডেন্টকে উদ্দেশ্য করে লেখেন, “হরমুজ প্রণালী ঘিরে তার এই দিবাস্বপ্ন খুব দ্রুতই ভাঙবে। আর তা না হলে, বিভ্রান্ত এই লোকটির ভুল ধারণা আমরাই ভেঙে দেব।” প্রসঙ্গত, ক্যালিফোর্নিয়ার লস অ্যাঞ্জেলস শহরে ইরানের বাইরে ইরানি বংশোদ্ভূত সবচেয়ে বেশি মানুষ বাস করেন। সেখানে প্রায় ১ লাখ ৪১ হাজার ইরানি বংশোদ্ভূত মানুষ আছেন। #somoytv #NewsUpdate #InternationalNews

#WATCH | Delhi: On US Ambassador to India Sergio Gor's J&K visit, Former Ambassador Mahesh Sachdev says, "The visit by US Ambassador to India, Sergio Gor, to J&K was important in at least two ways. Firstly, he would not have visited this territory, which is somewhat controversial to some, without express permission from his State Department handlers. So, that they allowed him to go is one message. The second message is what he said after meeting the Chief Minister. The main component of that message was that J&K is an important part of India. This is an important statement in itself, and it is not hinged to any other consideration such as the Shimla Agreement, Article 370, talks with Pakistan, a settlement with China, etc. So, the statement by itself stands on its own and should be regarded as a duration of the new normal of United States policy on this issue. I would have felt even better had he said that it is an 'integral part of India', not just 'an important part of India', but these shifts are made in small driblets, and that too would be forthcoming, I hope." He adds, "The third part that you mentioned about tourism, about visits, is also important because the economy of this Union Territory is based on tourism. Let me recollect here that President Trump is essentially a real estate developer by profession, and he is interested in what the United States can transact from a particular situation in general, and what Trump Incorporated can gain from the situation in particular... Last year, he proposed Gaza as a project, as a tourist heaven. I would not rule out that, in case it is in the future unveiled that Trump Incorporated or others had plans for big tourism-related investments in J&K. So, it will have to await the advisory which restricts American citizens from visiting this area to be rescinded or amended, and other developments to take place. It's virgin territory for international real estate developers, groups, etc., and it's quite possible that there might be another angle to it." Video

Today, the US Golden Dome program is having the same effect. Russian strategists view the influx of dual-use US space companies as part of an effort to strategically defeat Russia. धोरणासंदर्भात उच्चस्तरीय बैठक पार पडली. मुख्यमंत्री फडणवीस म्हणाले, तरुण पिढी नशेच्या आहारी गेल्यानंतर उपाययोजना करण्यापेक्षा तरुणांना नशेच्या गर्तेत ढकलणाऱ्या प्रवृत्तींना प्रतिबंधित करावे, तरुणांच्या समस्या लक्षात घेऊन त्यांना सहानुभूतीने या दुष्टचक्रात जाण्यापासून रोखावे. नशामुक्त महाराष्ट्रासाठी शासकीय यंत्रणेचा दृष्टिकोन महत्त्वाचा ठरणार आहे. सर्व संबंधित विभागांनी आपली जबाबदारी ओळखून प्रभावी भूमिका बजाविल्यास पुढील काळात निश्चितच नशामुक्त महाराष्ट्र घडविता येईल. नशेच्या दुष्टचक्रात अडकलेल्या तरुणांना यामधून बाहेर पडण्यासाठी प्रत्येक शासकीय रुग्णालयामध्ये नशामुक्ती केंद्रे स्थापन करण्याच्या सूचना देत मुख्यमंत्री फडणवीस म्हणाले, वैद्यकीय शिक्षण विभागाच्या सर्व शासकीय वैद्यकीय महाविद्यालयांमध्ये नशामुक्ती केंद्रे कार्यान्वित करावीत. राज्यामध्ये केंद्र शासनाच्या माध्यमातून कार्यरत असलेल्या नशामुक्ती केंद्रांचे सक्षमीकरण करण्यात यावे. यासाठी आवश्यकता असल्यास निधीची तरतूद करण्यात यावी. या केंद्रांच्या माध्यमातून नशामुक्तीचे प्रभावी कार्यान्वयन होण्यासाठी विशिष्ट कार्यप्रणाली विकसित करावी. नशामुक्त झालेली तरुणाई पुन्हा नशेच्या गर्तेत जाऊ नये, यासाठी नशामुक्ती केंद्रांच्या साखळीसोबतच त्यास कारणीभूत ठरत असलेल्या घटकांवर नियंत्रण आणावे, असे निर्देश मुख्यमंत्री फडणवीस यांनी यावेळी दिले. शाळा आणि महाविद्यालयांचा परिसर टपरीमुक्त असावा प्रत्येक शाळा आणि महाविद्यालयांचा परिसर हा टपरीमुक्त असावा, याबाबत कुठलीही तडजोड करता कामा नये, सर्व शैक्षणिक संस्थांचा परिसर हा अमली पदार्थमुक्त असावा. संबंधित शैक्षणिक संस्थांच्या प्राचार्य, मुख्याध्यापक यांनी शैक्षणिक आस्थापनेचा कॅम्पस अमली पदार्थमुक्त घोषित करण्याची कार्यवाही करावी. शालेय शिक्षणात अमली पदार्थांचे दुष्परिणाम यावर आधारित अभ्यासक्रमाच्या समावेशाची कार्यवाही पूर्ण करावी. अमली पदार्थ विषयक गुन्ह्यांमध्ये एनडीपीएस (नार्कोटिक ड्रग्ज अँड सायकोट्रॉपिक सबस्टन्सेस ॲक्ट) सारख्या कायद्यांचा प्रभावी उपयोग करीत गतीने निकालाची कार्यवाही पूर्ण होण्यासाठी जलदगती न्यायालये स्थापन करावी. यासोबतच अशा गुन्ह्यांच्या निपटाऱ्यासाठी केंद्र शासनाच्या धर्तीवर विशेष सरकारी अभियोक्त्यांच्या पॅनलची व्यवस्था करावी, हे पॅनल राज्य शासनाच्या अधिकारांतर्गत नियुक्त करण्याची तरतूद असावी, असे निर्देश मुख्यमंत्री फडणवीस यांनी यावेळी दिले. नशामुक्त महाराष्ट्राचे स्वप्न साकार करण्यासाठी संपूर्ण शासकीय यंत्रणेचा सर्वसमावेशक दृष्टिकोन असणे गरजेचे आहे, यासाठी सकारात्मक दृष्टिकोन ठेवत अमली पदार्थांशी निगडित संपूर्ण परिसंस्थेवर नियंत्रण आणावे. समाजामध्ये अमली पदार्थांविषयी जनजागृती करण्यासाठी जगातील यशस्वी पद्धतींचा अभ्यास करीत प्रभावी संदेश प्रणाली विकसित करावी. नशेच्या दुष्टचक्रात चुकीने आलेल्या तरुणांना कुठेही गुन्हेगार असल्याची मानसिकता तयार होऊ देऊ नये. त्यांना नशामुक्ती केंद्राच्या माध्यमातून सकारात्मक आयुष्याचा अनुभव द्यावा. तसेच, नैसर्गिक अमली पदार्थांचे उत्पादन करीत असल्याचे निदर्शनास आल्यास त्यांच्यावर कठोर कारवाई करण्यात यावी, असे निर्देशही मुख्यमंत्री फडणवीस यांनी यावेळी दिले. तरुणांमध्ये नशा करण्याची लक्षणे आढळल्यास त्यावर तातडीने उपाययोजना करण्यात याव्यात. अमली पदार्थविरोधी कारवाईत जिल्हास्तरीय समित्यांची भूमिका अत्यंत महत्त्वाची आहे. या समित्यांच्या कार्याचे मूल्यमापन करण्यात यावे. त्यांच्या कामगिरीच्या आधारावर जिल्ह्यांची रँकिंग पद्धत विकसित करावी. तसेच मुख्यमंत्र्यांच्या अध्यक्षतेखाली राज्यस्तरीय ‘एन कॉर्ड’ शिखर समितीची स्थापना करण्यात यावी, असे निर्देश मुख्यमंत्री फडणवीस यांनी यावेळी दिले. महाराष्ट्रात अमली पदार्थांच्या विरोधातील कारवाई 2023 मध्ये एनडीपीएस (नार्कोटिक ड्रग्ज अँड सायकोट्रॉपिक सबस्टन्सेस ॲक्ट) अंतर्गत ₹897 कोटी किमतीचे 43,632 किलो अमली पदार्थ जप्त करण्यात आले आहेत. तर 2025 मध्ये जप्तीच्या कारवाईत 2023 च्या तुलनेत 29% वाढ नोंदविण्यात आली आहे. यावर्षी 56,206 किलो अमली पदार्थ जप्त करण्यात आले. त्यांची किंमत ₹1,340 कोटी आहे. किमतीच्या दृष्टिकोनातून 49% वाढ नोंदविण्यात आली आहे. यावेळी राज्यमंत्री डॉ. पंकज भोयर, राज्यमंत्री योगेश कदम व वरिष्ठ अधिकारी उपस्थित होते. @Dev_Fadnavis @DRPANKAJBHOYAR @iYogeshRKadam #Maharashtra #DevendraFadnavis Now that I’ve had a little time to reflect on DEF CON 34, I think what stays with me most isn’t actually standing on the stage. It’s the people. Of course, seeing a full house at Recon Village while talking about something I care deeply about - OSINT, critical thinking, and the cognitive consequences of relying too heavily on AI - was incredibly special. But walking around DEF CON afterwards and having people stop me just to say hello, tell me they enjoyed the talk, challenge an idea, or continue the conversation… That genuinely meant a lot to me. I got to reconnect with old friends and somehow leave Vegas with a whole bunch of new ones. And I got to spend several days surrounded by hackers, researchers, investigators, builders, curious minds and people who simply look at the world differently. That’s probably what I’ll remember most. I came to DEF CON to share some of my thoughts. I’m leaving having had my own thinking challenged and expanded in return. And perhaps that’s exactly what a gathering like DEF CON should do. So thank you DEF CON and Recon Village for having me. Thank you to everyone who came to the talk. And especially thank you to everyone who stopped me somewhere along the way just to talk, laugh, share an idea, grab a drink or say hello. I’m humbled, grateful, slightly exhausted, and leaving with far more ideas than I arrived with. DEF CON, you’ve been an absolute blast. I’ll be back. P.S. I will re-record my talk I gave at DEFCON and post this on my Github/Youtube. Please have a little patience with that. It will be online soon. #defcon34 #reconvillage #osint #ai @defcon @ReconVillage

Proud to be addressing over 200 of our Tribal law enforcement partners from around the country in Albuquerque, making a huge announcement – the FBI’s new “Voices Not Forgotten” program – our initiative to take on unsolved investigations into homicides, kidnappings, and missing persons in Indian Country. This is a brand-new protocol that is part of this FBI’s record dedication of resources to Tribal partners who have been left behind for far too long. The new initiative is designed to raise public awareness, as well as create a minimum reward of up to $25,000 for all publicly advertised cases involving homicides, kidnappings, and missing persons in Indian Country – compelling any member of the public with information to come forward and help us bring justice. We are harnessing the same public awareness campaign that has made our Top Ten Most Wanted and Most Wanted Fraudster programs so tremendously successful – the public is one of our best resources. We’re highlighting six unsolved cases initially – including Angel Beach, Sa’wade Birdinground, Maleeka “Mollie” Boone, Logan Warrior Goings, Mary Johnson (Davis), and Emily Pike. We will continuously add to this list. If any member of the public has information – 1-800-CALL-FBI or tips.fbi.gov. Thank you to our IC partners for their great work with this FBI – special thanks to Shawn Butler, IACP Vice Chair; Bill Denke, IACP Chair; and our Albuquerque law enforcement partners for hosting. -DKP🇺🇸

In Aspirational District Malda, West Bengal, the Aamar Malda initiative is transforming the district’s identity by celebrating its rich agricultural heritage, skilled artisans, and local entrepreneurship, while creating sustainable livelihood opportunities. Through a hub-and-spoke model, Gram Panchayats identify and promote their signature products under Amar Gram Amar Kalpana, a district-led initiative. A dedicated Aamar Malda boutique provides a common platform for marketing GI-tagged mangoes, mulberry silk, terracotta, bamboo crafts, jute products, and SHG-made goods under a trusted district brand. Launched on 7 July 2026, the initiative is strengthening market access through a transparent Producer ID system, QR-based traceability, and assured payment mechanisms, while empowering producers across the district. With women-led Self-Help Groups, Farmer Producer Organisations, artisans, and border communities at its core, Aamar Malda is demonstrating how innovation, convergence, and grassroots participation can turn local enterprise into an engine of inclusive growth and sustainable livelihoods. #AspirationalDistrictsProgramme #AamarMalda @PMOIndia @narendramodi @Rao_InderjitS @MIB_India @PIB_India @DDNewslive @ashoklahiribjp

टँकरग्रस्त गावांना ‘जलयुक्त शिवार 3.0’मध्ये प्राधान्य! मुख्यमंत्री देवेंद्र फडणवीस यांच्या अध्यक्षतेखाली आज वर्षा निवासस्थान, मुंबई येथे मृद व जलसंधारण विभागाची बैठक पार पडली. यावेळी राज्यातील जलसंधारण, पाणलोट क्षेत्र विकास, शेतीची उत्पादकता वाढवणे आणि विविध विभागांमध्ये समन्वय साधून जलसुरक्षा सुनिश्चित करण्याबाबत चर्चा झाली. महाराष्ट्रातील मागील 5 वर्षांत टँकरद्वारे पाणीपुरवठा करावा लागलेल्या पाणीटंचाईग्रस्त गावांचा जलयुक्त शिवार अभियान 3.0 मध्ये प्राधान्याने समावेश करून, या गावांमध्ये जलसंधारणाची कामे तातडीने हाती घ्यावीत, तसेच या गावांमध्ये स्थानिक भौगोलिक परिस्थिती आणि पाण्याची गरज लक्षात घेऊन जलसंधारणाची कामे निश्चित करावीत असे निर्देशही मुख्यमंत्री फडणवीस यांनी दिले. मुख्यमंत्री फडणवीस म्हणाले, राज्यातील सूक्ष्म पाणलोट क्षेत्रांचा विकास आणि जलस्रोतांचे बळकटीकरण याला प्राधान्य देणे आवश्यक आहे. ज्या प्रकल्पांची कामे निश्चित करण्यात आली आहेत, त्यासाठी आवश्यक निधी उपलब्ध करून दिला जाईल. या कामांना प्राधान्याने गती देण्यासाठी सर्व संबंधित विभागांनी समन्वयाने नियोजन करावे, त्यामुळे जलसंधारणाची कामे अधिक परिणामकारकपणे आणि थेट पद्धतीने पूर्ण करता येतील. जलस्रोतांच्या बळकटीकरणामुळे निर्माण झालेला सकारात्मक परिणाम नागरिकांपर्यंत पोहोचविण्यासाठी जलसंधारणाशी संबंधित यशकथा तयार करून त्यांचा प्रभावी प्रसार करावा, असेही निर्देश मुख्यमंत्री फडणवीस यांनी दिले. यावेळी मंत्री संजय राठोड व वरिष्ठ अधिकारी उपस्थित होते. @Dev_Fadnavis @SanjayDRathods #Maharashtra #DevendraFadnavis #SoilAndWaterConservation

In modern combat, the effectiveness of unmanned systems depends on their EW resilience. FPV drones that rely on a constant communication link with the operator often lose control during the final phase of flight. The TFL-1 autonomy module solves this problem by enabling the drone to autonomously complete the mission in the event of signal loss. TFL-1 is compatible with most radio-controlled FPV drones and is already integrated into the most widely used models from leading manufacturers. Video

Israeli leaders should stop selling their public the illusion that the region can simply move on. Egypt is not going to assume responsibility for governing Gaza. And the regional map itself has changed: Saudi Arabia, Qatar and Turkey have significantly improved their relations, while Egypt and Turkey have undergone their own rapprochement. So what regional reality is this strategy actually based on? For years, Israeli policy has increasingly embraced the idea that the Palestinian question could be bypassed — that Israel could deepen its integration into the Middle East, expand the Abraham Accords and eventually normalize relations with Saudi Arabia without making consequential political choices on the Palestinian front. That assumption looks increasingly detached from reality. The Abraham Accords were an important diplomatic achievement, but they should not be mistaken for proof that the Palestinian issue has become irrelevant. Saudi Arabia is not the UAE, and the political environment after the Gaza war is not the Middle East of 2020. This matters for Washington as well. An American strategy built around a grand Israeli-Saudi bargain cannot succeed simply by offering Riyadh enough bilateral incentives while treating the Palestinian component as an obstacle to be managed. Saudi leaders have their own domestic, regional and Islamic considerations, and those cannot simply be wished away. If this is also the foreign-policy doctrine of Israel's next government, then a change of leadership will produce remarkably little change in policy. Israel needs a genuine foreign-policy reset. That means abandoning strategies based on assumptions that no longer correspond to the region as it exists today. It means recognizing that Israel cannot indefinitely separate regional integration from the Palestinian question. A serious strategy begins with the region Israel actually lives in — not the region Israeli politicians would prefer to imagine.
